text:
Maya C: planning a tiny canary for model_v6 — want to open a 5% burst to EU+NA for 30m to validate latency + quality. will monitor perf/diffs. trigger window at 11:15 PT. :rocket:
Liam R: sounds good. which flag/key are we toggling?
Maya C: flag is `toggle.model_v6_rollout`. command below for ops:```/toggle set toggle.model_v6_rollout --percent 5 --regions eu,na --duration 30m --note "mini ramp for v6 latency/accuracy smoke"```
Samir K: quick runtime check — v6 KV cache shape looks compatible with autoscale. just double-checking memory headroom on eu-gpu-pool.
Ava (oncall): i'll be on watch. please @ me when you flip. if errors > 1% or latency p50 bumps > 150ms i'll abort. :eyes:
Maya C: ping @Ava (oncall) at 11:14 and will flip at 11:15 then. I'll post metrics link after flip.
Liam R: add a guard: `--failover-model model_v5` so we fallback if responses error out.
Maya C: good call. updating command:```/toggle set toggle.model_v6_rollout --percent 5 --regions eu,na --duration 30m --fallback model_v5```
Priya D: also please record a small sample prompt set for eval so we can run quick toxicity/regression checks. I'll run an automated eval job once the canary hits steady state.
Maya C: sample prompt set is in /evals/model_v6/mini_smoke.tsv — will attach to the rollout note.
deploy-bot: scheduled toggle change: toggle.model_v6_rollout -> 5% (eu, na) at 2026-06-11T18:15:00Z by Maya C. ID: rb-toggle-9834.
Ava (oncall): flip acknowledged. if I don't post an abort within 10m assume green.
Samir K: quick heads-up — if you see kv cache misses spike, throttle threshold should be lowered to avoid queueing: set `runtime.batch.max_in_flight=200` temporarily.
Maya C: noted. i'll keep that in my notes and make the change if we see latency tail.
Liam R: also confirm observability dashboards have the new route filters for model_v6. I see a missing tag on one dashboard earlier.
Maya C: added tag `model:v6` to all routes. linking dashboard: https://console.redwood/inference/dashboards/rollouts/rb-toggle-9834
Priya D: will run eval at +10m and +20m. will post quick diffs.
Maya C: flip now (11:15 PT) — starting canary. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: toggle applied: toggle.model_v6_rollout = 5% (eu,na). Start: 2026-06-11T18:15:12Z.
Ava (oncall): initial smoke — p50 latency +40ms, error rate 0.02%. monitoring.
Priya D: first eval (11:25) small regressions on entity recall ~0.6% on a tiny subset, sending details.
Maya C: thanks. watching. if it creeps >1% we'll rollback.
Samir K: infra healthy, no pod OOMs. KV hit-rate steady.
Liam R: if Priya's diffs look acceptable we can bump to 15% in next window. agree?
Priya D: will confirm after the 20m eval. initial looks borderline but ok to hold at 5% for another 10m.
Maya C: holding at 5%. will reconvene at +30m, unless abort.
Ava (oncall): copy. will post an abort msg if anything breaches thresholds.
Maya C: thanks all — will post final status at 11:45 PT. :white_check_mark:
